name: com.liftmcp/company
title: LiftMCP
description: LiftMCP's own server: company and product info, a website AI-readiness check, and site onboarding.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get information about LiftMCP Ltd — the company behind the LiftMCP platform.

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Get information about the LiftMCP platform — what it does, how it works, and key concepts.

tools.name: check_site_readiness
tools.description: Check how ready a website is for AI agent interaction. Returns an AI readiness score and breakdown.

url.description: The website URL to check (e.g. https://example.com)

tools.name: register_site
tools.description: Add a website to your LiftMCP organisation as a Property and get the server card to publish on it. Needs your organisation API key in the Authorization header. Safe to repeat: a site already added is found, not added twice. Next: publish the card exactly as given at the address given, then call verify_site.

domain.description: The site, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: Check the server card published on a site and, if it matches, verify the Property and switch on its MCP endpoint. Returns the endpoint and, on the first successful verify only, the MCP API key agents use to call it. Safe to repeat.

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: The status of one Property in your LiftMCP organisation, or of all of them if no propertyId is given.

propertyId.description: A Property id; leave out to list all
